name: Fighter Captain
body:
A captain is a leader of people in pitched battle. This archetype is meant to pair with the seasoned commander or drill sergeant archetypes.

Lieutenant (Ex)

At 1st level, a captain gains the service of a lieutenant. This functions as a cohort from the Leadership feat except as follows:

At 1st and 2nd levels, this cohort is a 1st-level warrior and cannot level up.
At 3rd level, this cohort exchanges their warrior level for a level in a class that grants proficiency in all martial weapons and they cannot multi-class until 7th level. The cohort cannot have the captain archetype or other archetype that grants a cohort.

The lieutenant gains Swift Aid as a bonus feat, and provides a +2 (rather than +1) bonus when using this feat to aid the captain. As a move action, the lieutenant can retrieve a stored item or an item on the ground and hand it to the captain. The captain does not have to take an action to receive the item, though they must be conscious and have a free hand. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity for the lieutenant or captain.

If a lieutenant dies, or is released from the captain’s service, a captain may gain a new lieutenant by scouting for potential candidates in a city or large town. This requires 1 day per 5 levels of the lieutenant to be recruited.

As long as a captain and their lieutenant are adjacent, the lieutenant is treated as having any teamwork feats the captain has. They also share any teamwork feats that function when two or more allies threaten the same target, as long as they both threaten the same target.

At 6th level, the captain gains Leadership as a bonus feat and need not meet the prerequisites. Their lieutenant must remain as their cohort however.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feats at 1st, 6th, and 12th levels.

Teamwork (Ex)

At 2nd level, a captain may choose teamwork feats in place of combat feats when gaining a bonus combat feat.

This ability modifies bonus combat feats but does not preclude archetypes that replace any bonus combat feats not directly noted in other abilities.

Battleleader (Ex)

At 4th level, a captain is treated as having Leadership for prerequisite purposes and may select any feat with Leadership as a bonus combat feat when choosing fighter bonus combat feats.
